summary: The CourseAssessment module handles course assessments through operations such as adding, updating, deleting, and validating assessments, using stored procedures with parameters from sessions.
purpose: To manage the life cycle of course assessments including creation, modification, retrieval, and validation.

workflows.name: CourseAssessmentAdd
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, CourseID, AssessorTypeCodeID, SubjectTypeCodeID, AssessmentTypeCodeID, AssessmentTemplateCodeID, OpenDaysAfterStart, CloseDaysAfterEnd, AssessorCanViewSubjectsAnswers, SubjectCanViewAssessorAnswers, ViewUntilDaysAfterEnd, OptionAppliedAssessorTypeCodeID

workflows.name: CourseAssessmentUpdate
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, AssessorTypeCodeID, SubjectTypeCodeID, AssessmentTypeCodeID, AssessmentTemplateCodeID, OpenDaysAfterStart, CloseDaysAfterEnd, AssessorCanViewSubjectsAnswers, SubjectCanViewAssessorAnswers, ViewUntilDaysAfterEnd, OptionAppliedAssessorTypeCodeID

workflows.name: CourseAssessmentSearchID
steps: Retrieve data and populate CourseAssessment object

workflows.name: CourseAssessmentSearch
steps: Retrieve data and populate list of CourseAssessment objects

workflows.name: CourseAssessmentValidation
steps: Retrieve data and populate AssessmentValidationResult object

conditions: If using default locale, descriptions use default fields, otherwise, alternate fields are utilized for localized descriptions
